title: Angiogenesis
summary: Formation of new blood vessels from pre-existing vasculature, driven by endothelial proliferation and migration.

title: VEGFR2
summary: Vascular endothelial growth factor receptor 2 — the principal endothelial receptor tyrosine kinase driving angiogenic signalling.

title: Nitric Oxide
summary: Small gaseous signalling molecule (NO) produced by nitric-oxide synthases with vasodilatory, cytoprotective and cell-signalling roles.

title: Cytoprotection
summary: Research framework describing molecules that protect cells and tissues from injury independently of any specific receptor pathway.

title: Pentadecapeptide
summary: A peptide composed of fifteen amino-acid residues.

title: Fibroblast
summary: Connective-tissue cell that synthesises extracellular matrix and collagen and coordinates directed migration during tissue repair.

title: FAK-Paxillin
summary: Focal-adhesion signalling axis coupling integrin engagement to directed cell migration and tissue-repair phenotypes.

title: Peptide
summary: Short chain of amino-acid residues joined by peptide bonds, typically fewer than about 50 residues.

title: Amino Acid
summary: Bifunctional organic molecule bearing both amino and carboxyl groups; the monomer unit of peptides and proteins.

title: Peptide Bond
summary: Covalent amide linkage between the carboxyl of one amino acid and the amino group of the next, releasing water.

title: Lyophilisation
summary: Freeze-drying — low-temperature dehydration of a frozen sample by vacuum sublimation.

title: Lyophilised Powder
summary: Dry porous cake or powder produced by freeze-drying an aqueous peptide solution.

title: Reconstitution
summary: Aseptic dissolution of a lyophilised peptide in a defined volume of sterile diluent.

title: Bioavailability
summary: Fraction of an administered dose that reaches the systemic circulation in an active form.

title: Half-life
summary: Time required for the plasma concentration of a compound to fall to half of its initial value.

title: Stability
summary: Capacity of a peptide to retain chemical structure, purity and activity over time under defined storage.

title: Molecular Weight
summary: Sum of atomic weights of all atoms in a molecule; for peptides, residue masses minus one water per bond.

title: Agonist
summary: Ligand that binds a receptor and produces the functional response of the endogenous activator.

title: Antagonist
summary: Ligand that binds a receptor without activating it and blocks the effect of an agonist.

title: Partial Agonist
summary: Ligand that activates a receptor but produces a lower maximal response than a full agonist.

title: Receptor
summary: Cellular protein that binds a specific ligand and initiates a defined intracellular signalling event.

title: Ligand
summary: Molecule that binds a receptor or other biomolecule with defined affinity to form a reversible complex.

title: Affinity
summary: Thermodynamic strength of a ligand–receptor interaction, quantified by the dissociation constant Kd.

title: Potency
summary: Concentration of a ligand required to produce a defined functional response (typically EC50 or IC50).

title: EC50
summary: Concentration of an agonist producing half of its own maximal response in a defined assay.

title: IC50
summary: Concentration of an inhibitor that reduces a defined response by 50% in a given assay system.

title: Pharmacodynamics
summary: Branch of pharmacology describing what a compound does to the organism and the mechanism responsible.

title: GPCR
summary: G-protein-coupled receptor — seven-transmembrane family that transduces ligand binding via heterotrimeric G proteins.

title: Signal Transduction
summary: Cascade of intracellular events by which a receptor converts a ligand-binding event into a cellular response.

title: Second Messenger
summary: Small intracellular molecule that relays and amplifies signals from a receptor to downstream effectors.

title: cAMP
summary: Cyclic adenosine 3′,5′-monophosphate — the central second messenger downstream of Gs-coupled receptors.

title: Protein Kinase A
summary: cAMP-dependent serine/threonine kinase that phosphorylates intracellular substrates on receptor activation.

title: HPLC
summary: High-performance liquid chromatography — the standard technique for assessing peptide purity.

title: LC-MS
summary: Liquid chromatography–mass spectrometry — hyphenated technique confirming peptide identity by intact mass.

title: Endotoxin
summary: Lipopolysaccharide from Gram-negative bacteria; a pyrogenic contaminant assayed during peptide manufacture.

title: LAL Assay
summary: Limulus amebocyte lysate assay — the standard method for detecting and quantifying bacterial endotoxin.

title: Certificate of Analysis
summary: Batch-specific quality document reporting identity, purity, endotoxin and related analytical results.

title: GLP-1
summary: Glucagon-like peptide-1 — an intestinal incretin hormone that potentiates glucose-dependent insulin secretion.

title: Incretin
summary: Gut-derived peptide hormone (GLP-1, GIP) that amplifies insulin secretion in response to oral nutrient intake.

title: Incretin Effect
summary: Greater insulin release from oral than intravenous glucose at equivalent glycaemia, mediated by GLP-1 and GIP.

title: GLP-1 Receptor Agonist
summary: Pharmacological class of peptides and small molecules that activate the GLP-1 receptor.

title: Biased Agonism
summary: Ligand-selective preference for one branch of a receptor's signalling output over another (e.g. G-protein vs β-arrestin).

title: Beta-Arrestin
summary: Adaptor protein family that binds phosphorylated GPCRs, driving receptor internalisation and arrestin-dependent signalling.

title: cAMP / PKA Signalling
summary: Canonical GPCR signalling module: Gαs elevates cAMP, activating protein kinase A on intracellular substrates.

title: EPAC2
summary: Exchange protein directly activated by cAMP (isoform 2); a PKA-independent cAMP effector important in β-cell exocytosis.

title: Gastric Emptying
summary: Rate at which stomach contents transit into the duodenum; slowed by GLP-1R activation via vagal pathways.

title: POMC Neuron
summary: Hypothalamic arcuate-nucleus neuron expressing proopiomelanocortin; anorexigenic node in central appetite regulation.

title: NPY Neuron
summary: Hypothalamic arcuate-nucleus neuron co-expressing NPY and AgRP; orexigenic node in central appetite regulation.

title: Insulinotropic
summary: Property of stimulating insulin secretion from pancreatic β-cells, typically in a glucose-dependent manner for incretins.

title: Glucagonostatic
summary: Property of suppressing glucagon secretion from pancreatic α-cells, contributing to reduced hepatic glucose output.

title: Acylation
summary: Covalent attachment of an acyl (typically fatty-acid) group to a peptide side chain to modify pharmacokinetics.

title: Albumin Binding
summary: Reversible non-covalent association of a molecule with serum albumin, prolonging plasma residence.

title: SNAC
summary: Sodium N-[8-(2-hydroxybenzoyl)amino]caprylate — the absorption enhancer used in oral Semaglutide.

title: Subcutaneous Administration
summary: Delivery of a drug into the subcutaneous fat, providing slow systemic absorption from the injection depot.

title: Steady State
summary: Pharmacokinetic condition in which drug input rate equals elimination rate — reached after ~5 half-lives of regular dosing.

title: Receptor Internalisation
summary: Endocytic removal of an activated receptor from the plasma membrane, typically after β-arrestin recruitment.

title: Desensitisation
summary: Diminished receptor responsiveness during sustained agonist exposure, mediated by phosphorylation and internalisation.

title: MACE
summary: Major adverse cardiovascular events — composite endpoint of cardiovascular death, non-fatal myocardial infarction and non-fatal stroke.

title: DIO Model
summary: Diet-induced obesity model — rodent (typically mouse or rat) fed a high-fat diet to model obesity and metabolic dysregulation.

title: Native GLP-1
summary: Endogenous glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1(7-37) / GLP-1(7-36)amide) — rapidly degraded by DPP-4 in plasma.

title: Oral Semaglutide
summary: Oral tablet formulation of Semaglutide co-formulated with the absorption enhancer SNAC (marketed as Rybelsus).

title: Semaglutide
summary: Long-acting synthetic GLP-1 receptor agonist derived from GLP-1(7-37) with a C18 fatty-di-acid supporting albumin binding.

title: Dual Incretin Agonism
summary: Concurrent activation of the GIP and GLP-1 receptors by a single ligand, exemplified by Tirzepatide.

title: GIP-Adipocyte Axis
summary: GIP-receptor signalling on adipocytes that modulates lipid handling and insulin sensitivity in adipose tissue.

title: Satiety Signalling
summary: Integrated central-nervous-system pathways in the hypothalamus and hindbrain that translate incretin engagement into reduced food intake.

title: Gs Protein
summary: Stimulatory heterotrimeric G protein (Gαs) that couples class B GPCRs to adenylyl cyclase and cAMP production.

title: C20 Fatty Diacid
summary: Twenty-carbon dicarboxylic acid used as the albumin-binding side chain of Tirzepatide, attached at Lys20 via a γGlu-2xOEG spacer.

title: Weekly Dosing Pharmacokinetics
summary: Pharmacokinetic profile — typically half-life of several days plus reversible albumin binding — that supports once-weekly subcutaneous administration.

title: SURPASS Programme
summary: Randomised trial programme evaluating Tirzepatide in adults with type 2 diabetes across monotherapy and active-comparator studies (SURPASS-1 through SURPASS-5).

title: SURMOUNT Programme
summary: Randomised trial programme evaluating Tirzepatide for weight management in adults with overweight or obesity (SURMOUNT-1 onwards).

title: HbA1c Endpoint
summary: Glycated haemoglobin measured as a percentage; standard endpoint for glycaemic-control research reflecting average blood glucose over the preceding two to three months.

title: Semaglutide vs Retatrutide
summary: Side-by-side comparison of Semaglutide (GLP-1 mono-agonist) and Retatrutide (GLP-1/GIP/GCG triple agonist) — receptor coverage, structural chemistry, pharmacokinetics, evidence maturity and research applications.

title: Semaglutide vs Tirzepatide
summary: Comparison of Semaglutide (GLP-1 mono-agonist) and Tirzepatide (GLP-1/GIP dual agonist) — receptor coverage, structural chemistry, pharmacokinetics and the published head-to-head evidence base.

title: Semaglutide vs Liraglutide
summary: Comparison of Semaglutide (once-weekly, C18 di-acid) and Liraglutide (once-daily, C16 mono-acid) — shared receptor pharmacology, differing acylation chemistry, pharmacokinetics and evidence base.

title: SUSTAIN-6 — Semaglutide and cardiovascular outcomes in type 2 diabetes
summary: Randomised double-blind trial evaluating cardiovascular outcomes of once-weekly subcutaneous Semaglutide versus placebo in adults with type 2 diabetes at high cardiovascular risk.

title: STEP programme — Semaglutide Treatment Effect in People with Obesity
summary: Randomised trial programme evaluating once-weekly subcutaneous Semaglutide for weight management in adults with overweight or obesity, across multiple populations and comparators (STEP-1 through STEP-8).

title: SELECT — Semaglutide and cardiovascular outcomes in obesity without diabetes
summary: Randomised double-blind trial of once-weekly subcutaneous Semaglutide versus placebo in adults with overweight or obesity and established cardiovascular disease, without diabetes.

title: FLOW — Semaglutide and kidney outcomes in type 2 diabetes
summary: Randomised double-blind trial of once-weekly subcutaneous Semaglutide versus placebo evaluating kidney and cardiovascular outcomes in adults with type 2 diabetes and chronic kidney disease.

title: STEP-1 — Semaglutide 2.4 mg in overweight or obesity
summary: 68-week randomised double-blind placebo-controlled Phase 3 trial of once-weekly subcutaneous Semaglutide 2.4 mg in 1,961 adults with overweight or obesity without diabetes (Wilding et al. 2021).

title: STEP-2 — Semaglutide 2.4 mg in overweight or obesity with T2D
summary: 68-week randomised placebo-controlled Phase 3 trial of Semaglutide 2.4 mg and 1.0 mg vs placebo in adults with overweight/obesity and T2D (Davies et al. 2021).

title: STEP-3 — Semaglutide 2.4 mg + intensive behavioural therapy
summary: 68-week randomised placebo-controlled Phase 3 trial of Semaglutide 2.4 mg as adjunct to intensive behavioural therapy in adults with overweight/obesity (Wadden et al. 2021).

title: STEP-4 — Weight-loss maintenance vs Semaglutide withdrawal
summary: 68-week Phase 3 trial with 20-week Semaglutide 2.4 mg run-in and randomised continuation vs placebo, characterising maintenance and post-withdrawal weight regain (Rubino et al. 2021).

title: STEP-5 — Two-year Semaglutide 2.4 mg in overweight/obesity
summary: 104-week randomised double-blind placebo-controlled Phase 3 trial of Semaglutide 2.4 mg in adults with overweight/obesity (Garvey et al. 2022).

title: STEP-8 — Semaglutide 2.4 mg vs Liraglutide 3.0 mg
summary: 68-week randomised head-to-head Phase 3 trial of once-weekly Semaglutide 2.4 mg vs once-daily Liraglutide 3.0 mg in adults with overweight/obesity (Rubino et al. 2022).

title: SURPASS-1 — Tirzepatide monotherapy in T2D
summary: 40-week randomised placebo-controlled Phase 3 monotherapy trial of Tirzepatide 5/10/15 mg in adults with T2D on diet and exercise (Rosenstock et al. 2021).

title: SURPASS-2 — Tirzepatide vs Semaglutide 1 mg in T2D
summary: 40-week randomised head-to-head Phase 3 trial of once-weekly Tirzepatide 5/10/15 mg vs once-weekly Semaglutide 1 mg in adults with T2D on metformin (Frías et al. 2021).

title: SURPASS-3 — Tirzepatide vs insulin degludec in T2D
summary: 52-week randomised active-controlled Phase 3 trial of once-weekly Tirzepatide vs once-daily titrated insulin degludec in adults with T2D on metformin ± SGLT2 inhibitor (Ludvik et al. 2021).

title: SURPASS-4 — Tirzepatide vs insulin glargine, elevated CV risk
summary: Randomised active-controlled Phase 3 trial of once-weekly Tirzepatide vs once-daily titrated insulin glargine in adults with T2D and elevated CV risk, with pre-specified CV meta-analysis (Del Prato et al. 2021).

title: SURPASS-5 — Tirzepatide added to titrated insulin glargine in T2D
summary: 40-week randomised placebo-controlled Phase 3 trial of once-weekly Tirzepatide added to titrated insulin glargine in adults with T2D (Dahl et al. 2022).

title: Retatrutide Phase 2 Obesity Trial
summary: 48-week randomised placebo-controlled dose-ranging Phase 2 trial of once-weekly Retatrutide (1/4/8/12 mg) in adults with obesity without diabetes (Jastreboff et al. 2023).

title: Retatrutide Phase 2 Diabetes Trial
summary: 36-week randomised placebo- and active-controlled Phase 2 trial of once-weekly Retatrutide (0.5/4/8/12 mg) vs placebo and dulaglutide 1.5 mg in adults with T2D on metformin (Rosenstock et al. 2023).
